name: Data Processing and DPDPA Compliance
text: Where either Party collects, stores, or otherwise processes personal data of any individual (a 'Data Principal') in connection with this Agreement, that Party shall comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (the 'DPDP Act'), the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the rules thereunder, and all other applicable data-protection laws. (a) PURPOSE AND LAWFUL BASIS: personal data shall be processed only for the specific, lawful purpose for which it is collected and notified to the Data Principal, on the basis of the Data Principal's consent or another lawful basis permitted under the DPDP Act, and shall not be used for any incompatible purpose. (b) NOTICE AND MINIMISATION: each Party shall give the Data Principal a clear notice of the purpose and the data collected, shall collect only such personal data as is necessary for that purpose, and shall take reasonable steps to ensure the data is accurate and complete. (c) SECURITY SAFEGUARDS: each Party shall implement reasonable security safeguards (including access controls, encryption where appropriate, and organisational measures) to prevent personal data breaches, consistent with Section 8 of the DPDP Act and the reasonable security practices required under Section 43A of the Information Technology Act, 2000. (d) BREACH NOTIFICATION: in the event of a personal data breach, the affected Party shall notify the Data Protection Board of India and each affected Data Principal in the manner and within the timelines prescribed under the DPDP Act. (e) RETENTION: personal data shall be retained only for as long as necessary for the notified purpose or as required by law, and shall thereafter be erased, unless retention is mandated by applicable law. (f) DATA PRINCIPAL RIGHTS: each Party shall enable Data Principals to exercise their rights of access, correction, completion, updating, erasure, and grievance redressal as provided under the DPDP Act, and shall designate a contact for such requests. (g) PROCESSORS: any engagement of a Data Processor shall be under a valid contract that binds the processor to obligations no less protective than those in this clause. (h) CROSS-BORDER TRANSFER: personal data shall be transferred outside India only to the extent permitted under Section 16 of the DPDP Act and any restrictions notified by the Central Government. Each Party shall indemnify the other against losses arising from its own breach of this clause.
